name: Crypto-fascism
notAnIdeology: Crypto-fascism is a label for concealed or unacknowledged support for fascism, applied to individuals, organisations and cultural works (Adorno, Vidal, Böll), not a set of beliefs of its own; its positions are those of fascism or neo-fascism, already covered by the fascism and neo-fascism profiles.

sources.title: Crypto-fascism

sources.usedFor: Shows the article treats the term as a label for hidden or ambiguous fascist sympathies, not a distinct ideology.
